analyst.summary: Praj Industries makes ethanol-plant and bio-energy engineering equipment. FY26 profit fell 89% to Rs.24 Cr as India's initial ethanol-blending capacity build-out matured and new greenfield orders slowed -- a real, identifiable industry-cycle effect, not a one-off accounting item. The order book remains healthy (~Rs.4,491 Cr) and a government mandate to accelerate ethanol blending nationwide by April 2026 is a genuine tailwind, but none of this has yet shown up in margins, and the stock's headline valuation (~275-290x trailing earnings) only looks reasonable if a recovery that hasn't printed yet actually arrives. We rate this a Sell until the numbers confirm the turn.
